title: Riverwalk Mini Golf
gap: Duration of regular mini golf play not stated
blurb: Guests play on an 18-hole miniature golf course designed with colors and plant life found along the Riverfront. The course is beautifully landscaped and located right along the Wilmington Riverwalk. Soft serve ice cream, milkshakes, water ice, and sodas are available at the golf shack.

hours: Mo-Tu off; We-Sa 14:30-21:30; Su 12:00-19:00 || "Hours subject to weather and private rentals. Please check daily."
